database_summary: Baseball statistics dataset (Lahman-like) in SQLite. Contains player, team, park, college master/dimension tables plus season/event fact tables for batting, pitching, fielding (regular and postseason), appearances, salaries, awards, managers, postseason series, and home games. Many tables are seasonal/per-player or seasonal/per-team measurements; keys are composite (player_id+year+stint/pos/round/team).

accepted.name: player_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  birth_year,
  birth_month,
  birth_day,
  birth_country,
  birth_state,
  birth_city,
  death_year,
  death_month,
  death_day,
  death_country,
  death_state,
  death_city,
  name_first,
  name_last,
  name_given,
  weight,
  height,
  bats,
  throws,
  debut,
  final_game,
  retro_id,
  bbref_id
FROM player
accepted.description: One-row-per-player canonical player dimension. Use to join biographical attributes to stats. Preserves player identifiers and common name fields. | Use for: Attach player biographical info to stats; Filter players by birth country/years; List players with debut/final_game in a range

accepted.name: batting_stint
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  stint,
  team_id,
  league_id,
  g,
  ab,
  r,
  h,
  double,
  triple,
  hr,
  rbi,
  sb,
  cs,
  bb,
  so,
  ibb,
  hbp,
  sh,
  sf,
  g_idp
FROM batting
grain: player_id, year, stint, team_id (one row per batting stint)
accepted.description: Player-season-team-stint batting rows as provided (clean pass-through). Use as base for aggregations to player-season totals or joins to other tables. Keeps original grain so callers can aggregate as needed. | Use for: Aggregate batting stats to player-season totals; Compare stints across teams in same season; Filter batting by league_id or team_id

accepted.name: player_season_batting
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(ab,0)) AS ab,
  SUM(COALESCE(r,0)) AS r,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE(double,0)) AS double,
  SUM(COALESCE(triple,0)) AS triple,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(rbi,0)) AS rbi,
  SUM(COALESCE(sb,0)) AS sb,
  SUM(COALESCE(cs,0)) AS cs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so,
  SUM(COALESCE(ibb,0)) AS ibb,
  SUM(COALESCE(hbp,0)) AS hbp,
  SUM(COALESCE(sh,0)) AS sh,
  SUM(COALESCE(sf,0)) AS sf
FROM batting
GROUP BY player_id, year
grain: player_id, year (one row per player-season aggregated across stints)
accepted.description: Aggregated batting totals per player-season (sums across stints and teams). Useful for season-level leaderboards and joins to player or team-season data. Derived measure: AB (sum) and H (sum) etc. Grain: one row per player-year. | Use for: Season leaderboards (most hits, HR, RBI); Compute batting averages and rates by joining ab/h; Filter player seasons by minimum AB (post-filter)

accepted.name: player_season_pitching
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  SUM(COALESCE(w,0)) AS w,
  SUM(COALESCE(l,0)) AS l,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(gs,0)) AS gs,
  SUM(COALESCE(cg,0)) AS cg,
  SUM(COALESCE(sho,0)) AS sho,
  SUM(COALESCE(sv,0)) AS sv,
  SUM(COALESCE(ipouts,0)) AS ipouts,
  SUM(COALESCE(h,0)) AS h,
  SUM(COALESCE(er,0)) AS er,
  SUM(COALESCE(hr,0)) AS hr,
  SUM(COALESCE(bb,0)) AS bb,
  SUM(COALESCE(so,0)) AS so
FROM pitching
GROUP BY player_id, year
grain: player_id, year (one row per player-season aggregated across stints)
accepted.description: Aggregated pitching totals per player-season (sums across stints). Useful for season-level comparisons and rate calculations. Grain: one row per player-year. | Use for: Compute season ERA/WHIP after converting ipouts; List pitchers with most wins or strikeouts in a season; Filter pitchers by innings pitched (derived from ipouts)

accepted.name: fielding_by_pos
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  pos,
  SUM(COALESCE(g,0)) AS g,
  SUM(COALESCE(gs,0)) AS gs,
  SUM(COALESCE(inn_outs,0)) AS inn_outs,
  SUM(COALESCE(po,0)) AS po,
  SUM(COALESCE(a,0)) AS a,
  SUM(COALESCE(e,0)) AS e,
  SUM(COALESCE(dp,0)) AS dp,
  SUM(COALESCE(pb,0)) AS pb
FROM fielding
GROUP BY player_id, year, pos
grain: player_id, year, pos (one row per player-season-position)
accepted.description: Fielding stats grouped by player-year-pos (sums across stints/teams). Use to analyze defensive performance at each position per season. | Use for: Compare defensive stats across positions; Identify players who played multiple positions in a season; Compute fielding percentage by position

accepted.name: team_franchise_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.year,
  t.league_id,
  t.team_id,
  t.franchise_id,
  tf.franchise_name,
  tf.active,
  t.name,
  t.park,
  t.w,
  t.l,
  t.r,
  t.attendance
FROM team t
LEFT JOIN team_franchise tf ON t.franchise_id = tf.franchise_id
accepted.description: Join team-season rows to franchise metadata. Use to attach franchise_name and active flag to team-season records. | Use for: Analyze team performance by franchise status; Filter active/inactive franchises for seasons; List team seasons with franchise metadata attached

accepted.name: player_college_full
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.player_id,
  pc.college_id,
  pc.year,
  c.name_full,
  c.city,
  c.state,
  c.country
FROM player_college pc
LEFT JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
grain: player_id, year, college_id (one row per player-college-year association)
accepted.description: Map players to college details by year. Useful to find which college a player attended in a given year, with college name and location. | Use for: List players from a given college or state; Count players per college by year; Join college info to player career summaries

accepted.name: postseason_series
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  year,
  round,
  team_id_winner,
  league_id_winner,
  team_id_loser,
  league_id_loser,
  wins,
  losses,
  ties
FROM postseason
grain: year, round (one row per postseason series)
accepted.description: Postseason series records (one row per series-year-round) indicating winner and loser teams and results. Use for queries about champions and series outcomes. | Use for: List World Series winners by year; Analyze postseason matchups and outcomes; Join postseason winners to team-season records

accepted.name: salary_player_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  SUM(COALESCE(salary,0)) AS salary
FROM salary
GROUP BY player_id, year
grain: player_id, year (one row per player-season salary total)
accepted.description: Player total salary per year aggregated across teams (sums multiple salary rows for same player-year). Useful to compute annual payroll per player for analyses and joins to seasonal performance. | Use for: Relate player salary to performance in same year; Identify highest-paid players in a season; Compute team payroll by summing salaries joined to team

accepted.name: all_star_participation
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  year,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN game_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS all_star_games,
  SUM(COALESCE(gp,0)) AS gp
FROM all_star
GROUP BY player_id, year
grain: player_id, year (one row per player-season summarizing All-Star participation)
accepted.description: All-Star appearances aggregated per player-season (counts across games/stints). Use to identify players who were selected as All-Stars in a season. | Use for: List All-Star players in a season; Count All-Star selections across career; Join All-Star participation to season performance

accepted.description: Hall of Fame voting/induction records per player-year. Use to filter inducted players or analyze voting history. | Use for: List inducted players and induction year; Analyze voting totals and percentages; Join HOF status to player career stats
